what: LONG-TAIL BATCH F, STEP 4 — the Update pass that closes a switch action runs BEFORE the mega action, so an entry White Herb eats first.
written: 2026-09-06, BEFORE the measuring run, by ENGINE.

why_it_might_miss_HIGH: The row is an ORDERING, so both lines exist in both engines and the game plays on — the batch-D/E re-parting mechanism applies in full. There is also a SECOND ordering row of the same shape in the artifact against an Abomasnow-Mega that is instrument-suspect rather than shared-coin; if it is the same defect the drop could be 2 rather than 1, which would show as a MISS LOW.
why_it_might_miss_LOW: See above — the second `whiteherb <> detailschange` row. It was NOT counted in this prediction because its any-bucket verdict is instrument-suspect and the brief forbids fixing against an unreadable draw; if it closes anyway that is a bonus and is recorded as a miss.
